# External Reference Repositories

Read-only mirrors of upstream projects used for research, pattern matching, or integration testing. Paths in other repos expect these clones to live here.

## Current Mirrors
- `anthropic-skills/` — Official Claude skills collection (`https://github.com/anthropics/skills`).
  - Use as the gold-standard reference for skill architecture (`skill-creator/`, etc.).
- (Add new entries here as they are cloned.)

## Usage Guidelines
- Treat these repositories as read-only; run `git pull` in each directory to update.
- Do not push changes upstream from this workspace.
- Document new additions with source URL and purpose.
